Getting started

The Acme API is a REST API with JSON request and response bodies. This guide shows how to install the SDK, authenticate with an API key and call your first endpoint. All requests need an access token.

Install the SDK

npm install @acme/sdk
pip install acme

Authenticate

Set the ACME_API_KEY environment variable, then create a client. The library reads the key from the environment.

import { Acme } from '@acme/sdk';
const acme = new Acme({ apiKey: process.env.ACME_API_KEY });
const res = await acme.widgets.create({ name: 'first' });

Webhooks

Configure a webhook endpoint to receive events. Each request carries a signature header; verify it with the SDK function acme.webhooks.verify() and the endpoint secret parameter.
